title: SenseNova-U1: Unified Multimodal AI with NEO-unify
summary: A native unified multimodal model series by SenseTime that integrates understanding, reasoning, and generation within a single end-to-end architecture. It utilizes a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone to process raw pixels and text tokens without separate encoders.
research_notes: Developed by SenseTime and Light-AI; represents a shift from modular adapters to native end-to-end multimodal intelligence.

evolution.summary: Following the initial release, the project introduced the A3B-MoT Mixture-of-Experts variant and 8-step high-speed inference weights. It currently supports GGUF quantization for consumer GPU deployment and native integration into agentic workflows.
